title: Japanese MLB Players Statcast 2015-2026
subtitle: Every regular-season pitch by {n_players} Japanese MLB players, 2015-2026
description:
# Japanese MLB Players Statcast (2015-2026)

Every **regular-season pitch** thrown or seen in MLB from 2015 to 2026 by the **{n_players} players** in this dataset: every player born in Japan (MLB StatsAPI birth country) who threw a pitch or batted in an MLB regular-season game in those seasons, plus two US-born players of Japanese heritage kept from the earlier version ({heritage}). One row per pitch, straight from Baseball Savant's Statcast search, with the player list and season stats from MLB StatsAPI.

## Corrections in this version (please read if you used the earlier one)

The earlier version (February 2026) was put together by hand and had errors:

- **Two wrong player ids.** {corrections}. The rows under those ids in the earlier japanese_mlb_pitching.csv were those other pitchers' pitches.
- **Missing seasons.** Shohei Ohtani's 2025 pitching, Yu Darvish 2016, Yoshihisa Hirano 2020, Kohei Arihara 2022 and Munenori Kawasaki 2016 were not in the files. They are now.
- **Mixed game types.** Spring training and postseason pitches were mixed in. This version is **regular season only** (game_type R).
- **"All MLBAM player IDs have been verified" was not true.** This version is built by a script that checks every file against MLB StatsAPI before upload (below).
- players.csv no longer has the hand-typed npb_team and note columns (the sources used here cannot check them).
- Pitchers' own plate appearances are now in the batting file.
- New: the 2026 season and {new_players}.

## Files

### japanese_mlb_pitching.csv ({size_pitching})
- **{rows_pitching} pitches** thrown by **{n_pitching_players} players** ({n_pitching_seasons} player-seasons), including position players' mop-up innings: {position_players_pitching}
- {n_columns} columns: all of Savant's Statcast columns, values as Savant serves them, plus `player_name_eng`

### japanese_mlb_batting.csv ({size_batting})
- **{rows_batting} pitches** seen by the players at bat ({n_batting_seasons} player-seasons, pitchers who batted included)
- Same columns as the pitching file

Both files also contain Savant's rows for **automatic balls and strikes** (description automatic_ball / automatic_strike: automatic intentional walks since 2017, usually four rows per walk, and pitch-clock violations since 2023). They are not pitches (StatsAPI does not count them) and almost all have no tracking data; drop them for pitch-level work.

### players.csv
One row per player: MLBAM id, name, birth country/city/date, position, bats/throws, MLB debut, MLB teams, the seasons in each pitch file, and whether (and under which wrong id) the player was in the earlier version.

### season_summary.csv
{rows_summary} rows, one per player, season and role: MLB StatsAPI regular-season stats and StatsAPI sabermetrics (wOBA, wRC+, FIP, xFIP, WAR; MLB's own calculation), next to the number of Statcast rows of the same player-season.

## Players

**Pitchers ({n_pitchers}):** {pitchers}

**Position players ({n_position_players}):** {position_players}

Grouped by StatsAPI primary position; Shohei Ohtani (two-way) is listed with the pitchers and is in both pitch files.

## Key columns

| Category | Columns |
|---|---|
| **Pitch** | pitch_type, pitch_name, release_speed, release_spin_rate, spin_axis, release_extension, arm_angle |
| **Movement** (feet) | pfx_x, pfx_z, api_break_z_with_gravity, api_break_x_arm, api_break_x_batter_in |
| **Location** | plate_x, plate_z, zone, sz_top, sz_bot |
| **Batted ball** | launch_speed, launch_angle, hit_distance_sc, bb_type, hc_x, hc_y |
| **Expected stats** | estimated_ba_using_speedangle, estimated_woba_using_speedangle, estimated_slg_using_speedangle, woba_value |
| **Bat tracking** | bat_speed, swing_length, attack_angle, attack_direction, swing_path_tilt |
| **Game context** | game_date, game_pk, inning, balls, strikes, outs_when_up, at_bat_number, pitch_number |
| **Win / run value** | delta_home_win_exp, delta_run_exp, delta_pitcher_run_exp |

Column descriptions for every file are in the Data tab.

## How it is built

`build.py` in [yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets](https://github.com/yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets) (folder japanese-mlb-players-statcast), run on GitHub Actions:

1. Players: every MLB StatsAPI season roster 2015-2026 with birth country Japan, plus the two heritage players. A player-season counts when StatsAPI shows regular-season pitches thrown or plate appearances.
2. Pitches: one Baseball Savant Statcast search per player, season and role, regular season only.
3. The build fails and publishes nothing unless: every player-season has Statcast rows; every row has the requested season, game type R and player id; Savant's player name matches StatsAPI's for that id; each player-season's number of pitches equals StatsAPI's pitch count; no pitch appears twice; every player of the earlier version is kept (or its id corrected as above); and the restored seasons above are present.

## Analysis ideas

- Pitch arsenals of Japanese pitchers (Darvish's many pitch types, the splitters of Senga, Yamamoto, Imanaga and Sasaki)
- How NPB pitchers adapt in their first MLB season (the 2026 class: Tatsuya Imai; hitters Munetaka Murakami and Kazuma Okamoto)
- Ohtani as pitcher and batter across seasons
- Bat tracking comparisons (Ohtani, Suzuki, Yoshida, Murakami)
- Join season_summary.csv to pitch-level features to relate process to results

## Sources

- [Baseball Savant](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/statcast_search) Statcast search (MLB Advanced Media)
- [MLB StatsAPI](https://statsapi.mlb.com) for the player list, names, bio and season stats
